title: Natural Domain and Asymptotes of Tangent Functions
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the natural domain and the equations of all vertical asymptotes of the scaled tangent function f(x) = tan(2x).

steps.title: Analyze the Tangent Ratio
steps.explanation: The tangent function is defined as the quotient of sine and cosine. Singularities occur wherever the denominator cosine vanishes.
steps.why: Quotient definitions require the denominator to be nonzero.

steps.title: Find the Zeroes of the Denominator
steps.explanation: Cosine equals zero at all odd multiples of pi/2.
steps.why: Periodic zeroes of cosine on the real coordinate line.

steps.title: Solve for x to State Domain and Asymptotes
steps.explanation: Dividing the singularity equation by 2 yields the locations of the vertical asymptotes. The domain is all real numbers excluding these points.
steps.why: Linear scaling of the argument divides the asymptote coordinates by the scaling factor.
